project.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
project.subtitle: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed data products
project.author: Michael Seth Williams
project.business_problem: Operations leaders need one trustworthy path from batch quality observations and sensor telemetry to traceable decisions, without hiding rejected data, history, failures, or operating cost.
project.recruiter_takeaway: I engineered a reproducible Azure lakehouse that makes ingestion, quality, history, orchestration, recovery, performance, governance, monitoring, cost, and teardown independently inspectable.

hero_path.title: Two ingestion modes, one governed data product
hero_path.what: I designed a bounded batch and streaming path through ADF, Event Hubs, ADLS Gen2, Azure Databricks, Delta, and Unity Catalog.
hero_path.why: The diagram makes service purpose, trust boundaries, storage layers, and operating controls legible in one view.

hero_path.title: Reusable PySpark with explicit quality routing
hero_path.what: I separated Bronze provenance, Silver conformance, quarantine, temporal history, and Gold publication into tested modules.
hero_path.why: Thin entrypoints and deterministic contracts make the logic reviewable, rerunnable, and safe to evolve.

hero_path.title: A dependency-aware Lakeflow Jobs DAG
hero_path.what: I defined preflight, landing verification, parallel batch and stream ingestion, quality gates, Silver and SCD2 paths, Gold, validation, and evidence receipt tasks.
hero_path.why: Task dependencies isolate failures and enable repair without repeating successful upstream work.

hero_path.title: Lineage designed into table operations
hero_path.what: I use catalog-qualified table operations, explicit object ownership, comments, tags, and scoped grants to preserve inspectable lineage.
hero_path.why: A recruiter can trace Gold outputs back through Silver and Bronze rather than accept a diagram as proof.

hero_path.title: Controlled failure, focused repair, deterministic recovery
hero_path.what: I reserve one hard contract violation, capture the failed task, repair only the affected path, and compare clean and recovered hashes.
hero_path.why: The incident demonstrates operational judgment, not just a successful happy path.

hero_path.title: Three-by-three Spark measurement without cherry-picking
hero_path.what: I compare median baseline and optimized runs on the same compute using a separate five-million-row skewed fixture.
hero_path.why: Wall time, shuffle, spill, task duration, stages, and partitions are published even if optimization does not improve runtime.

engineering_journey.title: Architecture and deployment
engineering_journey.summary: Subscription-scope modular Bicep, what-if, expected-resource reconciliation, and Trial-only guardrails.

engineering_journey.title: Identity and security
engineering_journey.summary: Managed identities, Access Connector, resource-group-scoped RBAC, Key Vault isolation, and GitHub OIDC.

engineering_journey.title: ADLS Gen2
engineering_journey.summary: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, deliberate landing, checkpoint, quarantine, and evidence paths.

engineering_journey.title: Azure Data Factory
engineering_journey.summary: Parameterized ForEach and Copy ingestion from six commit-pinned deterministic files.

engineering_journey.title: Event Hubs streaming
engineering_journey.summary: Twenty thousand bounded messages, explicit schema, Kafka-compatible Structured Streaming, checkpointing, and reconciliation.

engineering_journey.title: Unity Catalog
engineering_journey.summary: Catalog and schemas, storage credential, external locations, ownership, grants, metadata, and governance demonstration.

engineering_journey.title: Bronze provenance
engineering_journey.summary: Source fidelity plus file, system, ingest time, event time, run ID, record hash, and schema version.

engineering_journey.title: Quality and quarantine
engineering_journey.summary: Warning metrics, drop behavior, explicit quarantine reasons, and one real fail-on-violation contract.

engineering_journey.title: Silver conformance
engineering_journey.summary: Schema enforcement, types, units, keys, joins, deduplication, domain validation, and idempotent outputs.

engineering_journey.title: CDC and SCD Type 2
engineering_journey.summary: AUTO CDC definition with deterministic MERGE fallback, preserved history, and one-current-version validation.

engineering_journey.title: Gold data products
engineering_journey.summary: Two facts, three dimensions, and one KPI output with documented grain, keys, lineage, and validation SQL.

engineering_journey.title: Lakeflow orchestration
engineering_journey.summary: A ten-task dependency graph on bounded ephemeral compute with aggressive auto-termination.

engineering_journey.title: Lineage
engineering_journey.summary: Table-name-based operations preserve the path from sources through Bronze and Silver into Gold.

engineering_journey.title: Failure and recovery
engineering_journey.summary: Reserved hard failure, root-cause receipt, focused repair, and clean-versus-recovered validation.

engineering_journey.title: Performance
engineering_journey.summary: Five-million-row skew fixture, three baseline and three optimized runs, median comparison, and truthful outcome.

engineering_journey.title: Monitoring and cost
engineering_journey.summary: Diagnostic settings, discovered Log Analytics tables, controlled alert condition, and timestamped cost labels.

engineering_journey.title: CI/CD
engineering_journey.summary: Local, security, IaC, bundle, publication, Pages, and OIDC-backed controlled deployment workflows.

engineering_journey.title: Verified teardown
engineering_journey.summary: Exact-scope deletion, managed-resource-group handling, budget removal, and authoritative absence polling.

engineering_journey.title: Evidence methodology
engineering_journey.summary: Every major claim binds platform capture, code, receipt, validation, UTC time, commit, and SHA-256.

pdf_pages.title: Quality-Critical Azure Lakehouse
pdf_pages.statement: From batch and streaming telemetry to governed, traceable data products.

pdf_pages.title: Trust has to survive the whole data path
pdf_pages.statement: Operations needs to know whether a batch stayed within limits, what changed, which records failed, and where every KPI originated.

pdf_pages.title: Two ingestion modes. One governed lakehouse.
pdf_pages.statement: ADF lands deterministic batch files while Event Hubs feeds bounded telemetry into checkpointed Structured Streaming.

pdf_pages.title: The evidence spans the engineering lifecycle
pdf_pages.statement: Provision, secure, ingest, transform, govern, orchestrate, break, repair, measure, monitor, publish, and tear down.

pdf_pages.title: Trial-only infrastructure with fail-closed cost gates
pdf_pages.statement: Subscription-scope Bicep creates only the isolated resource group and expected Azure service set.

pdf_pages.title: Managed identity is the default trust path
pdf_pages.statement: ADF, the Access Connector, and deployment automation receive scoped access without long-lived cloud passwords.

pdf_pages.title: ADLS Gen2 separates landing, checkpoints, quarantine, and evidence
pdf_pages.statement: Hierarchical namespace, TLS 1.2, disabled shared keys, and deliberate paths make state and ownership clear.

pdf_pages.title: ADF ingests six commit-pinned source files
pdf_pages.statement: A parameterized ForEach and Copy pattern preserves file-level execution and transfer evidence.

pdf_pages.title: Runs are reconciled by files, rows, bytes, and status
pdf_pages.statement: The final evidence binds the ADF pipeline and activity output to landed ADLS objects.

pdf_pages.title: Twenty thousand deterministic telemetry messages
pdf_pages.statement: The producer is bounded, seed-controlled, receipt-producing, and excludes its connection material from output.

pdf_pages.title: Explicit schema, checkpoint, metadata, append semantics
pdf_pages.statement: Streaming proof combines Event Hubs ingress, progress metrics, checkpoint existence, and Bronze Delta counts.

pdf_pages.title: Governance belongs inside the data path
pdf_pages.statement: Catalog-qualified tables, storage credentials, external locations, ownership, grants, tags, and policies create inspectable control.

pdf_pages.title: Raw does not mean unaccountable
pdf_pages.statement: Bronze preserves source file and system, ingest and event time, pipeline run, record hash, and schema version.

pdf_pages.title: Warn, quarantine, drop, and fail are different decisions
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow expectations publish warning metrics, route bad records, and enforce one reserved hard contract failure.

pdf_pages.title: Bad records stay explainable
pdf_pages.statement: Deterministic reason codes retain invalid keys, timestamps, ranges, units, duplicates, and unknown references for inspection.

pdf_pages.title: Conformance creates a dependable analytical boundary
pdf_pages.statement: Explicit types, keys, units, domain rules, joins, deduplication, and idempotency shape validated tables.

pdf_pages.title: History is preserved, not overwritten
pdf_pages.statement: AUTO CDC is preferred, with a deterministic Delta MERGE fallback and one-current-version proof.

pdf_pages.title: Six outputs with explicit business grain
pdf_pages.statement: Two facts, three dimensions, and a site-product-date KPI table each document keys, lineage, and validation SQL.

pdf_pages.title: The DAG exposes dependencies and recovery boundaries
pdf_pages.statement: Parallel Bronze paths converge at quality, Silver and SCD2 run in parallel, then Gold, validation, and receipt publication complete.

pdf_pages.title: Gold should be traceable to Bronze
pdf_pages.statement: Table-name-based Unity Catalog operations are designed to generate actual source-to-product lineage.

pdf_pages.title: Traceability reaches the field level
pdf_pages.statement: The selected evidence path follows a quality or temperature field from source through conformance into a Gold measure.

pdf_pages.title: A reserved hard violation breaks the real task
pdf_pages.statement: The incident is isolated, deterministic, and captured with the platform diagnostic rather than simulated in presentation code.

pdf_pages.title: The failure points to one violated contract
pdf_pages.statement: The root-cause note connects the malformed schema version to the affected quality task and excludes unrelated upstream work.

pdf_pages.title: Repair the failed path, preserve completed work
pdf_pages.statement: Lakeflow repair is used where the Trial runtime supports it; otherwise the exact limitation remains explicit.

pdf_pages.title: Recovery is verified by content, not appearance
pdf_pages.statement: Counts, duplicates, aggregates, and deterministic clean-versus-recovered hashes must all reconcile.

pdf_pages.title: A separate five-million-row fixture creates an honest test
pdf_pages.statement: Three baseline runs record wall time, stages, tasks, shuffle, spill, partitions, max duration, and p75 duration.

pdf_pages.title: Broadcast the small dimension; remove needless repartitioning
pdf_pages.statement: Three optimized runs on the same compute are compared by medians, with the measured result preserved even if slower.

pdf_pages.title: Operational evidence crosses service boundaries
pdf_pages.statement: Diagnostics ingest before execution; KQL uses the tables that actually appear and an alert is only called fired if it fires.

pdf_pages.title: Cost labels state exactly what billing can prove
pdf_pages.statement: Snapshots use actual, current, estimate, or pending-settlement labels while $15 and $20 gates control retries and teardown.

pdf_pages.title: Every release travels through validation
pdf_pages.statement: Python, Spark, Bicep, bundle, content, accessibility, secret, metadata, PDF, and Pages checks run before publication.

pdf_pages.title: The lifecycle ends with authoritative absence
pdf_pages.statement: Only the isolated resource groups and Part 4 budget are deleted, then Azure readback is polled until absence is confirmed.

pdf_pages.title: Inspect the complete engineering journey
pdf_pages.statement: Every major claim connects to platform capture, implementation, receipt, validation, time, commit, and hash across the repository, live case study, evidence explorer, and teardown record.

boundaries.databricks: Trial only; no paid Premium fallback
boundaries.teardown: Only the isolated Part 4 resource group, its Databricks-managed resource group, and the Part 4 budget
